sloka: अप्रहृष्ट बलाम् न्यूनाम् विषमस्थाम् अनावृताम् ।शत्रवो न अभिमन्यन्ते भक्ष्यान् विष कृतान् इव ॥२-८८-२५॥
transliteration: aprahṛṣṭa balām nyūnām viṣamasthām anāvṛtām ।śatravo na abhimanyante bhakṣyān viṣa kṛtān iva ॥2-88-25॥

translations.english: Now the gates of our capital city (Ayodhya) are wide open. The city is unprotected and endangered. There are no guards to keep vigil over the ramparts. The horses and elephants are not in control (hence unprepared for battle). The army is unhappy and demoralised. At this state even the enemies will not like to seize the city, they will shun it like food mixed with poison.
